notes_for_editor: The 1941 date and CCC attribution rest on one trail guide that cites Living New Deal. The Living New Deal page returned 403 to fetch_text; a WebFetch summary of it (not cached, so not quoted here) gave the builder as Unknown with CCC and Work Relief Programs listed, 'potentially by the CCC', and status Extant. That summary also gave coordinates 36.873366, -90.404899, about 150 m from the record's point (36.8739, -90.4056). Not proposed as a correction without a second check. No source gives height, design, or staffing. The Central US Lookouts page gives only the name, county, agency and location code.
